Relax and Refresh with Friends

College life gets busy fast. Everyone needs a break once in a while. Students can visit nearby cafes or peaceful spots to relax after classes and spend quality time together.

Places like Cafe Miracle near Chinnakakani and OpenCafé on the Parimi–Neerukonda Road offer a pleasant atmosphere for students to enjoy snacks, coffee, and group discussions. These cafes are ideal for celebrating birthdays, completing assignments together, or simply taking a break from daily routines.

"Sometimes the best memories are made during the shortest trips."

Explore Nearby Attractions

Students looking to explore beyond the campus can visit several well-known attractions around Guntur and Amaravati.

A visit to the Buddhist Archaeological Museum in Amaravati offers a glimpse into the region's rich history and cultural heritage. Those who enjoy scenic views can spend an evening at Prakasam Barrage, where the Krishna River and city lights create a peaceful atmosphere.

For students interested in outdoor fun, Speedway7 provides an exciting recreational experience that's perfect for weekends with friends.

"Every journey, no matter how short, teaches us something new."

Find Peace in Nature

Not every outing needs to be adventurous. Sometimes, a quiet park or a walk in nature is enough to relieve stress after a hectic week.

Students can enjoy relaxing evenings at Gujjanagundla Park or take a walk around Koritepadu Cheruvu, both of which provide calm surroundings for conversations, photography, or simply enjoying nature. Those who enjoy greenery and trekking can also explore Nidumukkala Hill Forest, located not far from the college.

"A peaceful place can refresh the mind better than a long vacation."
